text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. speaker: Doctor
text: Does the rash involve the eyebrows, ears, or diaper area, and have you tried any treatments so far? Are there any other family members with a history of eczema or allergies?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on scalp and forehead. I also have Erythematous patches, Greasy yellow scales, Worse in cold weather.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The presence of greasy yellow scales on the scalp and forehead in a 3-month-old infant is classic for seborrheic dermatitis, often referred to as cradle cap. Given the clinical presentation, I am confident in my assessment.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic dermatitis
